Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a new document titled “Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test — completed metric scorecard.” Summarize the completed experiment in a concise scorecard covering total traffic and arm counts, the routed-out primary result, admission-completion and support-time guardrails, consistency across the weekly and stabilization cohorts, and the concurrent pricing-page change check.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test — completed metric scorecard", "body": "## Completed experiment scorecard

- **Traffic / allocation:** 3,286 organic pricing-page sessions — 1,639 control and 1,647 treatment.
- **Primary outcome (routed out for an existing unsupported condition):** 38/344 control starts (11.0%) versus 25/352 treatment starts (7.1%); **35.7% relative reduction**, exceeding the predeclared ≥25% reduction threshold.
- **Admission-completion guardrail:** 43.8% control versus 44.1% treatment (**+0.3 percentage points**); within the maximum 1.5-point decline limit.
- **Support-time guardrail:** Account-level support time at the 90th percentile was 71 minutes control versus 74 minutes treatment (**+3 minutes**); within the maximum +10-minute limit.
- **Cohort consistency:** The favorable route-out direction held in all three complete weekly cohorts and the November 10–16 stabilization cohort; both guardrails remained within limits.
- **Concurrent pricing-page change check:** No unrelated pricing-page layout or UI change occurred during the test/stabilization window, supporting clean attribution.

**Readout:** The test cleared its path-quality threshold and both guardrails. This supports fewer unsupported self-serve starts; it is not evidence of revenue lift, paid-acquisition economics, pipeline impact, forecast credit, or changed Helio Start eligibility.", "folder": null}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_066_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The document accurately reports 3,286 organic pricing-page sessions in total, with 1,639 control sessions and 1,647 treatment sessions. The guardrail section accurately reports eligible-workspace admission completion of 43.8% in control and 44.1% in treatment, plus account-level support time at the 90th percentile of 71 minutes in control and 74 minutes in treatment. Missing or contradictory values fail.

The document states that the result direction held in all three weekly cohorts and in the final November 10–16 stabilization cohort, and that no unrelated pricing-page layout or UI change occurred. Missing or contradictory consistency or concurrent-change conclusions fail.", "value": {"title": "Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test — completed metric scorecard", "body": "## Completed experiment scorecard

- **Traffic / allocation:** 3,286 organic pricing-page sessions — 1,639 control and 1,647 treatment.
- **Primary outcome (routed out for an existing unsupported condition):** 38/344 control starts (11.0%) versus 25/352 treatment starts (7.1%); **35.7% relative reduction**, exceeding the predeclared ≥25% reduction threshold.
